questions.question: What does chapter 28 lay out at length?
options: Instructions for keeping all of the yearly festivals
Blessings for obedience and curses for disobedience
Duties assigned to the priests and the kings
Plans for the coming conquest of Canaan
questions.answer: Blessings for obedience and curses for disobedience

questions.question: What did God warn would happen if Israel disobeyed?
options: Their harvests would fail for only a single year
Their kings would come to rule over the surrounding lands
Their land would be given to the tribe of Levi
They would be cursed and scattered among the nations
questions.answer: They would be cursed and scattered among the nations

questions.question: Obedience would bring blessing in the city and in the field.
"_____ shall you be in the city, and blessed shall you be in the field," for obedience.
If they obeyed, the LORD would set Israel high above all _____ of the earth.
